USID_41 absorbs 42% of USID_00's dominant pixels with all absorbed pixels above -90 dBm (p50=-74.4 dBm, good zone). SINR regime is mostly_mild (85.7% interference-limited), so the backup signal is already competitive. Post-outage load factor of 0.009 presents negligible congestion risk.

USID_28 absorbs 16% of target pixels (all 100% low-SINR, mostly_mild regime). RSRP p50=-75.42 dBm is good (above -80 dBm threshold). Post-outage load factor of 0.004 is negligible.
